model_annotation: The chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty terms for different fine-tuned models, with the x-axis representing six medical specialties - Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics - and the y-axis labeled "Negative log probability" ranging from -27 to -22 in increments of 1. The chart contains grouped bars, with each group corresponding to a specialty term and comprising six bars representing different fine-tuned models, including Mistralv0.2-Base and five models fine-tuned on specific specialties, as indicated by the legend at the top. The bars are colored according to the legend, with Mistralv0.2-Base in light purple and the fine-tuned models in shades of orange and brown. The bars within each group are arranged in the same order as the legend, with the light purple bar representing Mistralv0.2-Base on the left and the fine-tuned models to its right. The height of the bars varies across groups and within groups, with the Cardio group having the tallest bar at around -22.5 and the shortest bar at around -27, while the other groups have bars ranging from approximately -23 to -26. The chart is not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
